svg.title: The reapernoid in three-space at four times
svg.desc: Four numerical rotational mean curvature flow slices starting near a unit-neck catenoid. The open annular neck expands away from the axis. All panels use the same camera and spatial scale. Finite-start approximation, not a certified eternal flow.

g.text: The reapernoid in ℝ³ · moving away from the axis
Numerical MCF · four times at one spatial scale · catenoid neck radius = 1
The surface changes shape; these are not dilations of a catenoid.
Two open rims are display cuts at x = ±2. Time is shifted so that u(0, 0) = 2.
Mramor–Payne, Theorem 1.3 and equation (2.7). Finite-start, truncated-domain approximation.
